name: Calendar
description: Sessions and events for the whole {environment} and for each {space}, with reminders.
author: Coffee Pub

settings.label: Open on
settings.help: The view the Calendar shows when you open it.

provides.name: createEvent
provides.label: Add it to the calendar
provides.description: Add an event to the calendar.

inputHints.title: The event's name.
inputHints.date: The first day, as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-20.
inputHints.time: Start time as HH:MM, 24-hour, for example 10:00. Leave it out for an all-day event.
inputHints.endTime: End time as HH:MM, on the same day or on endDate; it needs a start time.
inputHints.endDate: Last day of a multi-day event, as YYYY-MM-DD.
inputHints.allDay: True for an all-day event; do not send it with a time.
inputHints.repeat: One of: day, week, 2weeks, month, year.
inputHints.remind: Minutes before the start to remind people, from 0 (when it starts) to 40320 (28 days), for example 15, 60 or 1440. An all-day event counts from 9:00 on its day.
inputHints.remindAt: Instead of remind: when to remind people, as a date and time such as 2026-11-24 11:00, or a time on the event's day such as 9am. Times are the event's own clock time.
inputHints.notes: The event's details. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: updateEvent
provides.label: Change an event
provides.description: Change only the fields given of an event already on the calendar.

inputHints.event: The event to change, its pointer as search or an earlier answer gives it; a copy of another module's object is changed in that module.
inputHints.title: The new title.
inputHints.date: The new first day, as YYYY-MM-DD; its end moves with it.
inputHints.time: Start time as HH:MM, 24-hour, for example 10:00. An all-day event with a time is no longer all day.
inputHints.endTime: End time as HH:MM, on the same day or on endDate. "" clears it.
inputHints.endDate: Last day of a multi-day event, as YYYY-MM-DD. "" clears it.
inputHints.allDay: True makes it all day and drops its times; false needs a start time.
inputHints.repeat: One of: day, week, 2weeks, month, year. "" makes it not repeat.
inputHints.remind: Minutes before the start, from 0 (when it starts) to 40320 (28 days); an all-day event counts from 9:00. A new date keeps the minutes. "" takes the reminder off.
inputHints.remindAt: Instead of remind: a date and time such as 2026-11-24 11:00, or a time on the event's day such as 9am. Times are the event's own clock time. Moving the event keeps it as long before.
inputHints.notes: The event's details, which replace the old ones. Line breaks are allowed. "" clears them.
